usage: The word 泰國 (taai3 gwok3) is a noun used to refer to the country Thailand.
You can use 泰國 to talk about traveling, food, culture, or anything related to Thailand.
When mentioning the nationality or language, you might combine 泰國 with other words, but 泰國 alone means the country.
It often appears in conversations about holiday destinations or Asian countries.
泰國 does not change form for singular or plural; it always refers to the country itself.
